title: Runtime Error Lexicon and Observability Onramp
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a canonical runtime error lexicon and an ingestion onramp so errors from tracing hooks, metrics, and logs are normalized into a single telemetry stream. Scope: define error_class mapping (timeouts, overload, model_error, protocol_error, client_error, server_error, resource_exhaustion), failure_point (frontend, router, scheduler, executor, model), transport (http, grpc, internal), numeric codes (HTTP/gRPC), and model_error subtypes. Implement parser/transform rules in the metrics/log pipeline, wire tracing hook tags in the runtime, and produce dashboard templates and alert rules. Out-of-scope: changes to model code beyond instrumentation, large-scale retention policy changes.
comments: 2026-02-26 - Kickoff: synced with PM and Observability. Agreed lexicon should include error_class + failure_point + transport + code + downstream_cause. Action: draft canonical schema and mapping rules. Owner: Marco.

2026-03-02 - Prototype: tracing hook instrumentation added to runtime to emit error_code and error_reason tags. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2247 (WIP). Observability infra: draft fluentd parser config: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Runtime+Error+Parser.

2026-03-05 - Trade-off: normalized enums vs freeform strings. Decision: store numeric codes for HTTP/gRPC and enums for high-level classes to limit cardinality; detailed original_message preserved in raw payload for forensics.

2026-03-08 - Demo: shared Grafana wireframe (https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/err-lens/runtime-error-lens). Feedback: add per-model error-rate heatmap and SLO breach drilldown. Follow-up: add model_error subtypes (tokenization, generation_hang, backend_exception).

2026-03-10 - Blocker: legacy services emit status as text bodies (e.g., "status: unavailable"). Need ingestion-stage parsing and a fallback regex strategy. Infra to add checksum flag for unparsed records. Assigned related task: ENG-514002.
2026-03-10 - Next: finalize mapping table and publish parser config; route normalized events to telemetry.errors.normalized Kafka topic; build dashboard panels and alert rules.
next_steps: Finalize mapping rules and publish parser config
Wire transformed events to telemetry.errors.normalized topic
Build Grafana panels and Alert rules (SLO: 99.95% per-route)
Add backward-compatible agent to translate legacy text messages
acceptance_criteria: Tracing hook emits error_class and failure_point tags for 95% of runtime errors
Normalized events flowing to telemetry.errors.normalized topic
Dashboard panels show error breakdown by class, failure_point, transport, model within 1 minute
Alert rule fires on sustained >0.5% error_rate or SLO breach per-route
notes: This aligns with the observability roadmap to reduce MTTR and unify SLOs across hosted/dedicated/private. Requires coordination between Runtime, Infra, and Console teams.
status_updates: 2026-03-04 - Tracing hook prototype merged to feature branch
2026-03-10 - Parsing fallback design approved by Infra
customer_impact_notes: High for Dedicated customers with tight latency SLOs; improved error attribution expected to reduce noisy pages and speed triage by ~30%.
security_notes: Parsers must avoid capturing PII. Raw payload retention limited to 30 days; normalized stream contains no user content. Confirmed no KMS changes needed.
